editor_note: I checked the six rewritten entries (9, 44, 65, 67, 68, 69) against the English, looking at naturalness (check 1) and meaning drift (check 3) as you asked. None of them would mislead a learner. Error codes 4710 and 4712, the value mapping from "off" to 3, the default staying at 3, and the bitstring and variable_mapping descriptions all match the English. In entry 67, "Breaking changes" became "تغييرات جوهرية" ("significant changes"), which loses the point that these changes break existing code; the renamed parameters listed underneath make that clear, so it only counts as a dropped qualifier. Also in entry 67, "تُقابَل القيم السابقة كما يلي" and "عندما تم حل المسألة" sound translated and are worth smoothing. Entries 9, 44, 68 and 69 read naturally and are faithful to the English.

examples.why: 'جوهرية' means significant, not backward-incompatible. It drops the warning that existing code will stop working. The renames listed underneath make this clear, so it is minor and not misleading.

examples.source: The previous values map to ... / The field is `None` when the problem was solved during preprocessing
examples.translation: تُقابَل القيم السابقة كما يلي ... / يكون الحقل `None` عندما تم حل المسألة أثناء المعالجة المسبقة
examples.suggested: تتوافق القيم السابقة مع القيم الجديدة كما يلي ... / يكون الحقل `None` إذا حُلّت المسألة أثناء المعالجة المسبقة
examples.why: The passive 'تُقابَل' reads awkwardly here, and 'يكون ... عندما تم' mixes tenses in a way an Arabic technical writer would avoid.

editor_note: Entry 28 (the Table 1 caption) has no semantic drift. "وقت QPU ضئيل وشبه ثابت" keeps "minimal and almost constant", the causal link to "جولة واحدة فقط من QAOA" survives, and "بمعاملات دارة مثلى تم الحصول عليها على وحدة المعالجة المركزية" stays consistent with entry 15. The one slip is a redundant calque: "أسماء المثيلات تقابل أمثلة موافقة" says "corresponding" twice (the verb تقابل and the adjective موافقة). A native editor would drop one of them.

examples.source: Instance names are for corresponding examples in the [QOBLIB](https://github.com/ZIB-AOPT/QOBLIB) problem library.
examples.translation: أسماء المثيلات تقابل أمثلة موافقة في مكتبة مسائل [QOBLIB](https://github.com/ZIB-AOPT/QOBLIB).
examples.suggested: أسماء المثيلات هي أسماء الأمثلة المقابلة لها في مكتبة مسائل [QOBLIB](https://github.com/ZIB-AOPT/QOBLIB).
examples.why: Redundant calque: 'تقابل' and 'موافقة' both render 'corresponding', so the sentence reads stiffly. The meaning is intact.

editor_note: Following the user's "Do 1 and 3", I checked the three rewritten entries (40, 41, 44) for naturalness and semantic drift only. All the numbers survive intact (below 10% at width 9 / 10 qubits, 80–90%, about 15% near width 60, N = 50 / 51 qubits), and so does the caveat that exact results depend on calibration. Entry 44 renders "shot counts" as "عدد اللقطات", which literally means "the number of shots" and not the per-bitstring counts histogram; entry 51 already says "العدّات (counts)", so this is a mild wording slip. Two phrases are stiff calques: "تشغيلات التوسيع التمثيلية" in entry 41 and "مسح للأحجام" for "size sweep" in entry 44.

examples.source: the executable example below reports shot counts for one fixed hidden-bitstring width
examples.translation: يعرض المثال القابل للتنفيذ أدناه عدد اللقطات لعرض واحد ثابت
examples.suggested: يعرض المثال القابل للتنفيذ أدناه العدّات (counts) الناتجة عن القياس لعرض واحد ثابت
examples.why: 'عدد اللقطات' reads as 'the number of shots' and not the measured counts histogram the example actually reports. It doesn't match entry 51's 'العدّات (counts)'.

examples.source: this tutorial does not rerun a size sweep
examples.translation: لا يعيد هذا الدرس تشغيل مسح للأحجام
examples.suggested: لا يعيد هذا الدرس تشغيل التجربة عبر أحجام متعددة
examples.why: 'مسح للأحجام' is a literal calque of 'size sweep' and is unclear to an Arabic reader.

examples.source: The representative scaling runs below compare raw execution with Orbit configurations
examples.translation: تقارن تشغيلات التوسيع التمثيلية أدناه التنفيذ الخام مع تكوينات Orbit
examples.suggested: تقارن عمليات التشغيل التمثيلية أدناه، عند أحجام متزايدة، التنفيذ الخام بتكوينات Orbit
examples.why: The stacked noun phrase 'تشغيلات التوسيع التمثيلية' is translationese. 'تشغيلات' is an awkward plural, and 'قارن ... بـ' is more idiomatic than 'مع'.

editor_note: Both rewritten entries are faithful and read naturally: entry 72 keeps the gate order and roles (CNOT with Q كتحكم and Alice's qubit كهدف, then هادامارد on Q), and entry 73's prose, "لأن A و Q في نفس الموقع، دعنا نجمّع الحدود... وفقاً لنتائج القياسات", matches the English, with the math unchanged.

Per the user's "Do 1 and 3", only naturalness and semantic drift were judged, on the three rewritten entries (53, 78, 87). None of them changes the meaning: in 53, "fix the seed_transpiler option" is correctly rendered as فثبّت الخيار `seed_transpiler`, and "degenerate optima" in 78 is acceptably rendered as حلول مثلى متكافئة. One phrase in 78 is unclear. "addressed by variable name" became ويُشار إليه باسم المتغير, which reads as if the solution itself is called by a variable's name, when the English means its values are looked up by variable name. Outside the requested scope, entry 53 uses الدارة for "circuit" while the rest of the page uses الدائرة.

examples.source: Only the first solution is considered here, addressed by variable name.
examples.translation: يُؤخذ هنا الحل الأول فقط بعين الاعتبار، ويُشار إليه باسم المتغير.
examples.suggested: يُؤخذ هنا الحل الأول فقط بعين الاعتبار، وتُقرأ قيمه بحسب أسماء المتغيرات.
examples.why: The singular 'باسم المتغير' (by the variable's name) suggests the solution has a single name. The English means the solution is keyed by variable names, so a learner may misread how to access the result.

editor_note: Entry 60 keeps its meaning (benchmarking QFT process fidelity with the Orbit function from Quantum Elements) and would not mislead a learner. It has one terminology problem. It renders "a Qiskit Function" as "دالة Qiskit", which translates a product name that house style keeps in English. The same page already writes "Qiskit Functions" in English in entries 53, 54 and 57, and uses "وظيفة" for "function" in entries 58 and 59, so "دالة" also adds a third rendering. A smaller point: "قياس" for "Benchmark" is easy to read as quantum "measurement". Entry 87 already uses "قياس الأداء" for the benchmarking sense, so "قياس أداء" would be clearer here.

examples.source: with Orbit, a Qiskit Function by Quantum Elements
examples.translation: باستخدام Orbit، وهي دالة Qiskit من Quantum Elements
examples.suggested: باستخدام Orbit، وهي Qiskit Function من Quantum Elements
examples.why: House style keeps the 'Qiskit Functions' product name in English. 'دالة Qiskit' translates it and conflicts with the English 'Qiskit Functions' in entries 53, 54 and 57 and with 'وظيفة' in entries 58 and 59.

examples.suggested: قياس أداء QFT من حيث دقة العملية (process fidelity)
examples.why: In quantum material, a bare 'قياس' reads as 'measurement'. The benchmarking sense is clearer as 'قياس الأداء', the wording entry 87 already uses.

editor_note: Entry 12 is faithful and reads naturally. It uses the standard term الإحباط (frustration) and keeps the random positive/negative distribution of $J_{ij}$ (توزَّع عشوائيًا بين قيم موجبة وسالبة), the triangular example and the "every spin with every other spin" reason, all consistent with مغزل/المغازل elsewhere on the page.

The rewritten entries carry the meaning faithfully. Counts (3 child jobs, 300 PUBs each, 921,600 shots, 60 PUBs per N), conditions ("Provided that idles... are low enough error") and caveats (snapshot is not a performance guarantee; MEM only on dynamic/orbit) all survive intact. The main defect is that "unitary" is split in two: entries 0, 8, 10, 35, 42 use أحادي/الأحادية, but entry 17 uses الوحدوي. أحادي also collides with أحادية الكيوبت ("single-qubit") in the same paragraph, so it should be الوحدوي throughout. The smaller slips are a half-translated "مهام Runtime Batch child" in entry 5 (entry 4 already says مهام فرعية), a dangling trailing "QFT" in entry 35, and a loosely attached "وقت التشغيل" at the end of entry 21.

examples.source: compare raw unitary, raw dynamic, and Orbit-enhanced dynamic implementations
examples.translation: مقارنة التنفيذات الأحادية الخام، والديناميكية الخام
examples.suggested: مقارنة التنفيذات الوحدوية الخام، والديناميكية الخام
examples.why: أحادي means 'single/mono' and clashes with بوابات أحادية الكيوبت (single-qubit gates) in entry 17. Entry 17 itself renders unitary as الوحدوي, so the file is inconsistent. The same fix applies to entries 8, 10, 35 and 42.

examples.suggested: عبر ثلاث مهام فرعية في Runtime Batch
examples.why: English 'child' is left stranded inside the Arabic phrase. Entry 4 and entry 49 already render child job as مهمة فرعية.

examples.source: either the standard unitary QFT or its semiclassical dynamic QFT equivalent
examples.translation: إما QFT الأحادي القياسي أو مكافئه الديناميكي شبه الكلاسيكي QFT
examples.suggested: إما QFT الوحدوي القياسي أو مكافئه الديناميكي شبه الكلاسيكي
examples.why: The trailing 'QFT' copies English word order and is redundant after مكافئه. It also repeats the أحادي/وحدوي inconsistency.

examples.source: especially measurement and idling errors, at runtime
examples.translation: خاصة أخطاء القياس والخمول، وقت التشغيل
examples.suggested: ولا سيما أخطاء القياس والخمول وقت التشغيل
